youtube_title: Does Checking Your Credit Score Lower It? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Myth: checking your own credit score lowers it. Truth: when YOU check, it's a soft inquiry with zero effect. Your score moves on hard inquiries, when you apply for loans or cards, and many in a short time hurt. Rule: you can get 1 free full credit report a year from every credit bureau. Fix: open your report once a year and dispute any wrong loan or late-payment entry with the bureau.
Source: RBI (free annual credit report from each credit information company); TransUnion CIBIL FAQ.
Education only, not financial advice.

instagram_caption:
Score check karne se score girta hai? Bilkul nahi. 🙅‍♂️ Khud check = soft inquiry = ZERO asar. Score tab hilta hai jab loan/card ke liye apply karte ho (hard inquiry) — kam time mein bahut saari = damage. Aur har credit bureau se saal mein 1 full report FREE. Fix: saal mein ek baar report kholo, galat loan ya late payment dikhe toh bureau mein dispute daalo.
Tumne last time score kab check kiya tha? 👇
